notes.title: The PC in Goalgetter
notes.content:
[h1][b]The PC in Goalgetter[/b][/h1]

We have also further expanded the PC. In addition to the introduction of more statistics, there are now many investment options. Among other things, you have the possibility to create your own companies. The e-mails give you help and information where new data is available. Regularly there are also interview requests here, which one can then carry out by video call.

notes.title: The newspaper in Goalgetter
notes.content:
[h1][b]The newspaper in Goalgetter[/b][/h1]


After it has been a bit quiet lately, we want to use the next few weeks to introduce you to new features in Goalgetter. The first one is the newspaper. The newspaper will be displayed in the game on demand after every league and cup matchday and is also available in the living room table at any time.
The 3 pages are interactively filled with the data of the last match and the last matchday. Thereby the own performance in the last match, as well as the performance of the
team and the situation in the league under the magnifying glass. Here we have a few exclusive screenshots for you:
